addr: 84/1, Panathur Main Rd, near Vaswani Reserve, opp. S B I Bank, New Kaverappa Layout, Kadubeesanahalli, Marathahalli, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560103, India

rev.t:
We booked it for seemantha function.
The food was very good, except baby kulcha(it was too rubbery to chew).
Rest all food was very good, specially Gajar Halwa, Paneer lababdar, Methi Malai Matar, pineapple shilanji(welcome drink), Maccroni cucumber salad.
It was good n all the services offered was upto the mark . Restaurant manager Mr. Murugan was supportive n corporative. …
It was a wonderful experience celebrating my daughter's first birthday. The food was delicious, and the arrangements, organized by the manager, were excellent.
